title: 分享经历与见闻

sentenceFrames.pattern: ：I remember this one time when [past situation].
sentenceFrames.usage: 要讲一个具体的经历了。"One time" 比 "once" 更口语化、更有故事感。
sentenceFrames.example: I remember this one time when I got completely lost in Tokyo with no phone battery. It was terrifying but also kind of amazing.
substitutions: I remember this one time when **I tried to cook for 10 people and...
I remember this one time when **I said the wrong thing in a meeting and...
I remember this one time when **I met someone completely unexpected and...
I remember this one time when **I traveled to _____ and...
I remember this one time when I _____.

sentenceFrames.usage: 讲故事时拉近跟听众的距离。"right?" 让听众参与进来。这是母语者讲故事的核心技巧。
sentenceFrames.example: So I'm standing there, completely lost, right? And then this old lady comes up to me and starts speaking to me in Japanese, and I'm just nodding like I understand.
substitutions: So I walk into the interview, super nervous, right? And then _____.
So we're on the plane, about to take off, right? And then _____.
So I decide to try cooking this new dish for the first time, right? And then _____.
用自己的经历续写：So _____, right? And then _____.

sentenceFrames.usage: 讲故事的高潮——"结果呢..." 制造转折和意外感。
sentenceFrames.example: It turned out that the lady wasn't speaking Japanese — she was speaking really fast Korean the whole time.
substitutions: I thought I failed the test, but it turned out that _____.
I was worried about the presentation, but it turned out that _____.
I almost didn't go to that party, but it turned out that _____.
自己的经历：_____, but it turned out that _____.
